incident.acceptance_step: eval-suite development baseline (not an acceptance step)

stimulus.question: Checkout is reported to show elevated errors in the OTel Demo. Using the authorized metrics range query and trace search for the last 5 minutes, determine whether checkout and its dependency calls (payment, product-catalog, cart, currency, shipping, email) show failures or elevated latency, cite trace ids, and return a json investigation report.

claims.text: Checkout recorded zero error spans in the last 5 minutes: sum by (service_name) of increase(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"}[5m]) is 0 for checkout (and also 0 for cart, payment, frontend, frontend-proxy, load-generator); the only non-zero values are ad 1.25, flagd 1.25 and recommendation 1.25.

At operation granularity checkout's error series are all zero over the last 5 minutes: oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder, oteldemo.CheckoutService/prepareOrderItems, oteldemo.CartService/EmptyCart, oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge and prepareOrderItemsAndShippingQuoteFromCart all show status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR" increase 0, while the same operations' STATUS_CODE_UNSET increases are non-zero (8.75, 8.75, 8.75, 8.75, 8.75) — i.e. traffic continued with no error status recorded.

Checkout's own client-side gRPC calls to its dependencies succeeded in the last 5 minutes: rpc_client_duration_milliseconds_count for service_name="checkout" shows rpc_grpc_status_code="0" for oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge (11.25), oteldemo.CurrencyService/Convert (31.25), oteldemo.CartService/EmptyCart (11.25), oteldemo.CartService/GetCart (11.25), oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct (20.0), oteldemo.ShippingService/GetQuote (11.25) and oteldemo.ShippingService/ShipOrder (11.25); the non-zero status series that exist historically, rpc_grpc_status_code="2" for Charge and "9" for EmptyCart, both have increase 0 in this window.

Sampled checkout spans in the last 5 minutes carry success status only: 30 checkout spans show HTTP POST with http.status_code=200, oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder with rpc.grpc.status_code=0, and client spans for PaymentService/Charge, CartService/EmptyCart, ShippingService/GetQuote, ProductCatalogService/GetProduct and CurrencyService/Convert with rpc.grpc.status_code=0; error_by_visible_tags is false on every row. Trace ids observed: d36d6d5c15dd4373dbd2883cbad9784b, 9295040a174f06713d35ad6a44183f9d, e2212bf4ab759c2c59d229ebb9ea7005, be276a4d9d1b4b01c1921a4ed18a45d0, 1677bd440d72af4336598da457be9267, 96eb84831fecfa796d4ea17f5e75892f, ac1cca33612b0f61779539541ee2455d, e8a11c72b4a9f0b4cbbe0bcd0494edad, 4a98092f4be6fc1b64e6160c34ee6800.

A complete 45-span trace of a successful checkout, trace_id ac1cca33612b0f61779539541ee2455d, shows every dependency span OK with error_rows 0: checkout oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder 53112 us rpc.grpc.status_code=0, payment grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge 2494 us status 0, product-catalog oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct 103/70 us status 0, cart POST /oteldemo.CartService/EmptyCart 8097 us and POST /oteldemo.CartService/GetCart 532 us, currency Currency/Convert 1052/294 us with otel.status_code="OK";rpc.grpc.status_code=0, shipping oteldemo.ShippingService/GetQuote 4524 us status 0 and ShipOrder 20 us status 0, email POST /send_order_confirmation 11385 us http.status_code=200; end-to-end frontend POST /api/checkout returned http.status_code=200 in 57801 us.

payment's own spans in the last 5 minutes are successful and fast: grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge 2494 us, 2400 us and 2339 us with rpc.grpc.status_code=0, inner 'charge' spans 1058/1050/870 us, and the enclosing frontend grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder spans returned rpc.grpc.status_code=0 within traces ac1cca33612b0f61779539541ee2455d, 9295040a174f06713d35ad6a44183f9d and e2212bf4ab759c2c59d229ebb9ea7005.

Checkout latency is not elevated against a comparable same-length baseline window (2026-11-03T10:10:30Z–10:15:30Z): p95 of span_name="oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder" for service_name="checkout" is 96.5 ms in the current 5-minute window versus 160.0 ms in the baseline window.

Checkout's HTTP entry latency was flat over the last hour: p95 of span_name="HTTP POST" for service_name="checkout" reads 82.5 ms at 10:20:30, 47.3 ms at 10:25:30, one 170 ms point at 10:50:30, then ~47.4–48.0 ms for every point from 10:55:30 through 11:15:30 (latest 47.67 ms).

report_parsed.summary: In the last 5 minutes (2026-11-03T11:10:30Z–11:15:30Z) checkout shows no failing operations and no elevated latency, and neither do the dependencies named (payment, product-catalog, cart, currency, shipping, email). The reported 'elevated errors' is therefore not reproduced in the last 5 minutes; the only checkout error-span activity visible in the 24h series is in much earlier 15-minute buckets, the last one ending around 2026-11-03T00:30:30Z.
